# Leon Stewart (baseball)

Leon "Lefty" Stewart (September 5, 1915 – August 10, 1969) was an American baseball pitcher in the Negro leagues. He played with the Newark Eagles in 1936 and 1940. He later played with the Negro American League Birmingham Black Barons in 1942 as outfielder. Leon adopted the nickname "Lefty" because he batted right and pitched left
